action.action-desc: Ms. Lee of Florida introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on House Administration

form.official-title: To amend the Help America Vote Act of 2002 to require ballots in elections for Federal office to be received by the close of the polls on the date of election.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Ballots by Election Day Act.

subsection.text: Title III of the Help America Vote Act of 2002 (52 U.S.C. 20901 et seq.) is amended—

paragraph.text: by redesignating sections 305 and 306 as sections 306 and 307, respectively; and
by inserting after section 304 the following new section:

subsection.text: To be considered validly cast and eligible to be counted in any election for Federal office, including a primary, runoff, or special election, all ballots (including absentee and mail-in ballots) must be received by the appropriate election official no later than the time polls close on the date of the election and, in the case of a general election for Federal office, no later than the time polls close on the date established under section 25 of the Revised Statutes of the United States (2 U.S.C. 7) for each general election for Federal office.

No State may accept for tabulation any ballot (including an absentee or mail-in ballot) that is received by the appropriate election official following the time polls close on the date of the election.

The deadline described in subsection (a) shall not apply with respect to ballots cast by absent uniformed services voter or overseas voters, as defined in section 107 of the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act (52 U.S.C. 20310).
This section shall apply with respect to elections for Federal office held in 2027 or any succeeding year.
Section 401 of the Help America Vote Act of 2002 (52 U.S.C. 2111) is amended by striking and 304 and inserting 304, and 305.
The table of contents of such Act is amended—

paragraph.text: by redesignating the items relating to sections 305 and 306 as relating to sections 306 and 307, respectively; and
by inserting after the item relating to section 304 the following new item:

toc.toc-entry: Sec. 305. Deadline for receipt of ballots.
